title: fix(state): settle restart reads after caller retirement
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the restart-readiness regression introduced by #175307 without removing its revoked-caller and cancellation guarantees. When an old reply's lifecycle retires while a cold agent registration reports its already-completed COMMIT, the inner admission helper returned but the outer callback still checked caller authority. That refused a bookkeeping acknowledgement while the worker had an open connection but had not installed its identity. Settlement then replaced the expected stale-lifecycle refusal with an unknown-outcome error.

The committed-registration exception now ends the outer authorization callback. The admission observer still validates and records the exact registration receipt. The next validation and every actual operation still require live authority. First-use creation wrappers keep their independent checks, and genuine reporting failures still require retirement.

The queued-collector failure is a separate fixture assumption. Since #174111, “uncaptured lifecycle events publish current updated facts without predecessor label/swarm/capacity overrides.” The fixture selected only `reason: create`. It now selects the `sessions.changed` publication for either documented `create` or `updated` form, retaining all label, status, runtime, Stop and authorization assertions.

## Evidence

Main hourly [39025102777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39025102777) reported both failures. The correct restart job is `117374543019` (compact-small-10); the supplied `117374542980` is compact-small-7 and does not contain that test. The collector job is `117374542999`. Each log was fetched once.

- On current-main base `8839e329ea70`, a local diagnostic revert of #175307 passed both complete reported files: 48 tests. Restoring #175307 reproduced both cold-registration cases with the exact `unsettled native connection`/unknown-outcome signature. The diagnostic revert is not part of this PR.
- The natural collector run passed. A controlled initial projection-capture miss reproduced both exact CI assertions while the real broadcaster emitted a valid Collector B `updated` row with queued status and null runtime. The corrected selection passed that same forced condition. All temporary diagnostic hooks were removed.
- Final local Node proof with `--maxWorkers=1`: 122 passing cases across all eight execution test files, restart lifecycle, Gateway reclamation and reply admission; then all 26 collector cases passed. One pre-existing Linux-only killed-owner case is skipped on macOS and remains for CI. The native group took 205.30 seconds including preparation; the collector file took 62.71 seconds including preparation.
- Both targeted state-logging and Gateway-root test type graphs passed, as did type-aware core lint, formatting and `git diff --check`.
- Independent P0–P2 autoreview is scoped-clean. It confirmed that generic failed-report retirement remains intact and that the collector's substantive assertions are preserved.

The collector's publication contract predates the hourly window; no single new scheduling commit is claimed as its trigger. No retries, longer timeouts, schema changes or permission expansion. No workflow was dispatched or rerun. Ready for the lead to land after CI.
